testcase.name: Scenario: Add a selected command using the keyboard transfer button: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:993:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Add a selected command using the keyboard transfer button ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected ✔ And the Part | Tools custom target is empty ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list ✔ And the user presses Enter while the list has focus ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains selected in the available commands list ✔ And the Part | Tools target remains empty ✔ And Apply remains disabled ✔ When the user presses Tab and then Space ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the Part | Tools target ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ And Apply and cancels are enabled ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
